assumptions.capacity: Assumed 20000 parcels per station per day with 15 percent baseline headroom.
assumptions.fixed_cost: Assumed daily rent and fixed labor; test sensitivity rather than claim actual rent.
assumptions.delivery_cost: Assumed 1.5 USD per vehicle minute times two for return, divided by 200 parcels.
assumptions.congestion: Uniform assumed multiplier; no time-of-day calibration.
assumptions.coverage: Assumed station-to-cell drive-time limit after congestion adjustment.
